strings.refs.blocked_title: Blocked at step 1 — no reference image available
strings.refs.blocked_body: This build environment could not retrieve or display reference images (image search returned nothing; binary downloads from image hosts are not reachable). No reference image was visually inspected, so no design proposal, no reference sheet and no animation frames were produced. Per the pipeline rules, claiming otherwise would be dishonest.
